posts.body: How about an inflatable paddling pool? Blanket in the bottom. Someone I know did this with a large rectangular one and it was brilliant, easy to clean and transport to the relatives and useful in the garden later on….oh and cheaper

posts.body:
We used a hack stay and play for small time play at a very young age, it's a travel cot/play pen

However unless you have a lot of space I doubt the aglen will get much use as baby will be wanting to be out near you or whatever else is going on.

Of course a big play pen offers enough space for you to be in it as well.
